nav_selector: #content-nav (probe harness element serializing queryCollectionNavigation("content") into the generated /navtree page; the official content starter template renders NO navigation element of its own)
actual_rule_observed: The page landed in a new synthetic section /guides at top-level index 1, at child index 1 within it (child 0 is the _dir.yml file itself, which v3 treats as an ordinary page, not as directory config).
notes: landed_at_index=1 is the index within its section (full index path 1.1). Section mechanics measured in v3.16.1: (1) a directory with pages becomes a section node titled from content/guides/.navigation.yml ("Guides Section"), i.e. the v3 per-directory config file is `.navigation.yml`; (2) the v2 `_dir.yml` receives NO special handling in v3 — it was ingested as a regular page at /guides/_dir titled "Dir Yml Title"; (3) the `.navigation.yml` file itself is consumed as config and does not appear in the tree; (4) section position among top-level items follows the same stem-ASC order (about < guides < index). matched_documented_rule is false because the official docs page could not be loaded in this environment (see rule.json/searches.json).
